name: Endpoint Denial of Service
description: Adversaries may perform Endpoint Denial of Service attacks to degrade or block the availability of services to users by exhausting the system resources or application capacity of the endpoint. This includes application-layer floods, service exhaustion, and application exhaustion that overwhelm a specific service rather than the network link.
detection: Monitor for abnormal resource consumption, application errors, and a surge of requests to a single service or endpoint. Web server logs showing a flood of expensive requests indicate an endpoint DoS.
mitigations: M1037: Filter Network Traffic — rate limiting and WAF
